Alameda 的这一天，适合把好奇心与放空各留一半：登上 USS Hornet: Split an Alameda day between curiosity and relaxation: board USS Hornet to see aircraft and ship spaces and understand how a carrier operates, then head to the shoreline for water and birdlife. The museum and Crab Cove are separate destinations requiring a transfer; the beach is not simply at the foot of the gangway.
先订舰上重点，再安排海岸转场: Choose your museum priorities and plan the shoreline transfer
编辑建议留 4–5 小时，舰上约 2–3 小时，另留用餐、转场与海岸短走时间。: Editorial suggestion: allow 4–5 hours, including roughly 2–3 aboard, plus food, transfer time, and a short shoreline walk.
航母需购票，部分导览另收费；海岸散步无需景点门票，但停车与交通另计。: The ship requires admission and some tours cost extra. Shoreline walking requires no attraction ticket, but parking and transport are separate.
先到 707 W Hornet Avenue；想看特殊舱室要先查当日导览和身高等: Start at 707 W Hornet Avenue. For special compartments, check the day’s tours and restrictions such as height requirements; general admission does not guarantee access everywhere.
提前选好航母到 Crab Cove 的驾车或其他接续方式；若搭渡轮，另核对码头到: Choose how to get from the ship to Crab Cove in advance. If using a ferry, separately check the terminal-to-attraction connection and the final return leg.
两段行程，三处认真停留: Two parts, with three worthwhile stops
机库展览 → 开放甲板 → Crab Cove 海岸: Hangar exhibits → open deck areas → Crab Cove shoreline
按当天开放区域调整舰上顺序；第三站需要离馆后独立转场。: Adjust the shipboard order to the areas open that day; stop three requires a separate transfer after leaving the museum.
第一站 · USS Hornet 机库与展览: Stop 1 · USS Hornet hangar and exhibits
入馆先拿地图，向工作人员确认当天开放区域与想参加的导览，再从机库展览建立对整艘船: Collect a map at admission, confirm open areas and any desired tours with staff, and begin in the hangar to understand the ship as a whole. With children, choose one aircraft and one exhibit to examine closely, looking for details and purpose. There is no need to make every compartment a required stop.
第二站 · 当天可进入的甲板与舰上空间: Stop 2 · Decks and ship spaces open that day
根据工作人员指引与同行者行动能力，选择能进入的甲板或舱室，比较船体尺度与飞机之间: Follow staff guidance and your group’s mobility needs when choosing decks or compartments, comparing aircraft size with the scale of the ship. Leave space on steep ladders and hold the rails; children need adult supervision throughout. If ladders are unsuitable, remain in accessible exhibition areas and ask about the virtual visit in the hangar.
第三站 · 转场到 Crab Cove 海岸短走: Stop 3 · Transfer to Crab Cove for a shoreline stroll
离馆用餐后重新导航到 McKay Avenue 的 Crab Cove 入口，把: After leaving the museum and eating, navigate separately to the Crab Cove entrance on McKay Avenue. Slow down for bay views and a seated rest. Take a short out-and-back on open paved paths and visit the bay ecology exhibits if the center is open. Respect closures rather than completing the whole shore, and return to your original entrance when tired.
历史舰船与海滩，各有不同的通行条件: Ship and beach access need separate planning
官方明确提示舰上轮椅与推车通行非常有限，带婴儿背架也有禁限，订票前先联系场馆确认: The museum explicitly warns that wheelchair and stroller access is extremely limited, with restrictions on backpack-style infant carriers; contact it before booking to confirm what you can visit. Wear closed-toe shoes with grip and bring a layer for the decks and coast. In rain, focus on open indoor exhibits. Crab Cove has paved paths, but ordinary wheelchairs do not handle sand like pavement. Check water quality and conditions before swimming; Crown Beach has no lifeguards. Note parking gate closure signs before walking.

穿防滑包头鞋，带外套，按官网要求精简包袋。: Wear grippy closed-toe shoes, bring a layer, and pack within museum bag rules.
